summary: The prepared base invokes the instrumented external FlashInfer boundary for a valid zero-token MXFP4 MoE activation and fails there. The exact candidate skips only that boundary after routing/dispatch, preserves empty output shape, BF16 dtype, device, symmetric allocation, and padding trim behavior, rejects the previously reported malformed routing and hidden widths, and preserves the nonempty boundary call. This is a source-level full fix of the reported wrapper contract, not merely test hardening. Actual H20 FlashInfer CUTLASS and four-rank DP-attention/TBO execution remain unavailable in this ROCm environment.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before reproduction through the real MoeRunner with AMD GPU tensors and an instrumented external kernel boundary. The valid empty case reached the boundary and raised; malformed empty shapes were not rejected as required. Six tests failed.

Candidate-authored regression on one AMD Instinct MI355X: valid empty boundary suppression, symmetric allocation, output contract, nonempty control, token mismatch, routing widths 0/1/3, and hidden width 15. Six tests passed.

Independent GPU adversarial coverage: padded empty output trims to [0,16] and remains contiguous BF16 on-device without a kernel call; nonempty [2,16] reaches the boundary with [2,2] routing; rank-3 hidden/ids/weights and ids/weights shape disagreement reject before the boundary. Six tests passed.

gpu_execution.evidence: Tests allocated and operated on real torch CUDA-API tensors backed by one AMD Instinct MI355X (gfx950) under PyTorch 2.11.0+rocm7.2. Only the unavailable FlashInfer CUTLASS boundary was instrumented.

native_rebuild_reason: The candidate changes only Python and tests; repository-environment.json supplies no native target, and no native source or compiled extension changed.
remaining_limitations: Actual NVIDIA H20/SM90 FlashInfer CUTLASS kernel execution was not possible on the assigned AMD Instinct MI355X ROCm GPU.
The four-rank DeepSeek-V4-Flash DP-attention plus two-batch-overlap serving reproduction, distributed collective behavior, and real model weights were unavailable and remain end-to-end unverified.
The independent validation establishes the SGLang wrapper contract at the external kernel boundary; it does not qualify FlashInfer CUDA binaries or DeepSeek-V4 numerical semantics.
